## 🌍 Where you at, brother?

<!-- City/area + country. Rough is fine — "Southside Chicago" or "London, UK." Helps us connect you with brothers on the same block. -->

## 📱 What hardware are you working with?

<!-- THE most important question. Be honest — it changes what setup path we give you. -->

- [ ] 📱 Phone only (no computer at all)
- [ ] 💻 Scrap/old computer + EasyTether (USB phone internet)
- [ ] 🖥️ FED-OS machine (the founder's build)
- [ ] 📚 Library / public computer (time-limited sessions)
- [ ] 💪 Real machine, real internet — I'm here to build and give back

## 🎯 What are you trying to get out of this?

<!-- Honest answers only — there's no wrong one on this block. -->

- [ ] Escape a job I hate / get a real tech paycheck
- [ ] Build a side hustle (websites, bots, services for local businesses)
- [ ] Keep my son / nephew / little brother off the streets
- [ ] Second chance — I'm home from incarceration and need a path
- [ ] Pure love of the game — tech is real-life Minecraft to me
- [ ] Other (tell us below)

## 📆 How much time you got, real talk?

<!-- Hours per week you can realistically give. No shame in "2-4" — consistency beats intensity. -->

- [ ] 1-4 hrs/week (life is FULL — job, kids, parole, classes)
- [ ] 5-10 hrs/week (serious but busy)
- [ ] 10+ hrs/week (all in)
